title: neopanax simplex
intro: Neopanax simplex, commonly known as the Matapati or the New Zealand Matapati, is a plant species native to New Zealand, belonging to the family Araliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Maori medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Neopanax simplex include its ability to reduce pain, improve digestion, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
